blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Cebu Pacific has received its sixth aircraft delivery for 2026 as the airline strengthens its capacity for the upcoming peak holiday travel season. The budget carrier under the Gokongwei group recently welcomed an Airbus A320neo, its fourth delivery of this Airbus model this year, which arrived in Manila from Airbus’ facility in Tianjin, China. READ: Domestic flyers lift Cebu Pacific in lean September “As we approach the peak holiday travel season, having additional aircraft in our fleet helps us prepare for increased passenger demand,” Cebu Pacific President and Chief Commercial Officer Xander Lao said.
